subject.title: fix(dashboard): harden pinned MCP app authority

question: Can maintainers confirm that the retired pinned-MCP-App request shape has never shipped to a supported release or independently updated client, so this incompatible protocol removal needs no compatibility path?
rationale: The code changes a public Gateway protocol schema and generated client model; the PR states the predecessor data is unreleased, but only release ownership can safely confirm the supported upgrade contract.

options.title: Confirm unreleased-only contract
options.body: Confirm no supported release or independently updated client uses the retired descriptor, then retain the narrower server-derived request shape.

options.title: Preserve an upgrade path
options.body: Keep an additive or versioned parser for the retired request shape until affected released clients have an explicit migration window.

recommendation.title: Confirm unreleased-only contract
recommendation.body: Confirm no supported release or independently updated client uses the retired descriptor, then retain the narrower server-derived request shape.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the underlying durable pinned-MCP-App feature and are the strongest available owner for its release contract.
